detailed_description: The Image Flip & Rotate tool applies browser-side canvas transformations to one selected image. After uploading an image file, you can toggle horizontal or vertical flipping, choose 0, 90, 180, or 270 degree presets, adjust a 0-360 degree rotation slider, rotate by -90 or +90, reset the controls, preview the transformed canvas, and download the canvas as a PNG file. The tool works locally in the browser but does not preserve EXIF metadata, offer drag-and-drop upload, batch processing, original-format export, or lossless rotation guarantees.
usage_steps: Choose one image file from your device.
Use the horizontal and vertical flip buttons when needed.
Select a rotation preset, use the rotation slider, or rotate by -90 or +90 degrees.
Preview the transformed image on the canvas.
Download the transformed canvas as a PNG file.
usage_examples: Rotate a selected image by 90 or 180 degrees before downloading a PNG copy.
Create a mirrored version of a small graphic with the horizontal flip button.
Flip an image vertically and preview the result on the canvas.
Experiment with a custom rotation angle using the slider before exporting.
